title: Mixed Event — The Warmth of a Guiding Hand — Episode5 That Warmth At The Start

meta.Event: The Warmth of a Guiding Hand
meta.Episode: Episode5 — That Warmth At The Start
meta.Event Outline: With so much on their plate, it's getting harder for MORE MORE JUMP! to keep on top of their schedule. Shizuku suggests that Saito become the group's manager since she's proven her talents to them, but things are not so simple...

rows.Line: The next day
Ryusuiso - Peony Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whew!
As fun as today's shoot was, they had us do so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They told us that it'd be for a camping special, but chopping all that firewood was harder than I expected...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <We actually had a lot of fun watching you though.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yeah.
I think the special's gonna turn out really great!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That means a lot coming from all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Still...
We really worked up a good sweat.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I was hoping to take a bath... Why don't we all go together?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really wanna join you, but I still need to get my bags all sorted...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, Minori, you do have all your bags laid out...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've also been thinking about getting my things sorted, so I'll also join you in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I still have a few emails left that I need to reply to, so I'll head over once I'm finished with those.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, I'll go on ahead.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<No fair!
I wanna take a dip in the hot spring!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, it would've been nice to give my skin a refreshing treatment. Is there any way for you to bring back some of the water?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That may be difficult... Instead, we can bring back some manju. I'm sure you'll enjoy them very much.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<What?!
You mean the ones Saito brought over yesterday?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Awesome!
I promise to wait and be really patient♪>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh, you. But I understand your excitement.>
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(The baths should be... Ah, this way.
Thank goodness for all these signs.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Still, this inn really is lovely...
Our room feels relaxing, and the staff here are so kind...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (We talked it over a little after that...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And we agreed to respect Saito's decision to help keep her family's business going.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And I...agree with that, but...)
You're Ms. Hinomori, correct?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

Ah, I had a feeling.
Thank you for always being so kind to my granddaughter.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: I apologize for not introducing myself sooner. I am the previous proprietress of this inn, as well as Ayaka's grandmother.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Her grandmother...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I should be the one telling you how grateful we are for all the kindness she's given us.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
Hehe. I appreciate that very much.
And I'm so glad that I finally got to meet you.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: But... I suppose all the stories I'd heard were true. She really has been working with you...

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: You're the reason why she decided to start working part-time at events, so it seems fate is not without a sense of humor...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait, I am...?

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: Oh, did she not tell you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I... I knew that she's been a big fan of mine for a very long time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I had no idea that she chose to start helping with events because of me.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
If I recall...
I believe it all started about three years ago.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: Something about meeting you for the first time at a meet and greet...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: At a meet and greet? About three years ago...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...
That may've been the event where everyone from the third generation was introduced.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: I can't recall many details, but I do remember Ayaka making a bit of a mistake while helping out here and feeling bad about it.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: Apparently, you asked her if she was okay after noticing that something was bothering her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hello!
Thank you for coming to see us today!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh no... Is everything okay?
You seem to be feeling a little down.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But don't worry!
I know a charm for making people smile by shaking hands with me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All I have to do is...this!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After you release my hands, you should be able to move forward with your head held high. I hope that helps cheer you up.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: After that, she gained an interest in working as an event staff member.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: I suspect it's because she saw firsthand the power that events have to move hearts.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Saito...

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: But I doubt she ever dreamed of having the opportunity to work with you yourself someday.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which, you should've heard how happy she was when she called home after working on one of your group's events for the first time.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: She even kept sending us messages saying, “It's so amazing how hard she works,” and, “I'm giving MORE MORE JUMP! all the support I can!”

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: But above all else, she sounded the happiest when telling us how the event she helped put together actually succeeded.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: After helping put on your last event, I've decided that I want to assist and support idols for a living...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I ended up having so much fun that I found myself wanting to do this for a living.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: It felt like I played an actual role in helping spread hope to others like all of you. That made me feel so happy...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes...
She also told us the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: When she told us that, it became clear that she genuinely has a passion for our line of work... Her words left me speechless.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
Ah, yes, I'd imagine so.
Which is why I posed a question to her.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: If she likes it that much, then why not pursue it as a career?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How did she respond...?

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: She said...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
G-Grandma, what are you saying?
I want to serve this inn's guests for a living!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: That's why I'm going to become the next proprietress. My event staff job is just a way to build up experience.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: But you always sound so happy whenever you're talking about work.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: You don't need to worry about this inn. If there's something else that you wish to do, then I think you should pursue that.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: We care far more about your happiness than the future of this inn.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: My happiness matters more...?

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: Yes, so if you have a different dream in mind, then... I think you should try making it come true.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: No, you've got it all wrong!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I want to become the next proprietress of this inn! I've been planning to since I was in elementary school!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: So, Grandma, you don't need to worry.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: After graduation, I'm coming straight back here!

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
...
What I'm worried about is your...

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: We kept going around in circles after that...

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: But she was so adamant that I ended up saying, “It seems it really is your dream to take over.”

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: However, I'm still having a hard time actually believing that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So... Is her mother aware of any of this?

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
No.
I've taken it upon myself to hear what Ayaka has to say since her mother doesn't know much about the entertainment industry.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Please don't tell Mom about what we just talked about, okay, Grandma?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: I don't want her to worry, so... Please.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: This subject became a secret between just us after she said that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A secret between the two of you...?

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: However, I have a feeling that her mother would say the same thing as me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line: I mean, what parent doesn't want their child's dreams to come true?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (She's right...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Saito certainly seems to be placing the happiness of those she cares about above her own dream...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (And yet, those same people want her to pursue what she wants... They believe that's what will make her the happiest.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (They all care so much about each other, but... They're not on the same page at all.)

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
Oh, look at the time.
I'm sorry. I didn't mean to give you our whole family's story.

rows.Speaker: Senior Proprietress
rows.Line:
You were about to take a bath, yes?
Our spring's known for being both rejuvenating and good for your skin. I hope you have a soothing bath.
se_walk_women_004_2

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...
